title: Taking up string bass after his brother's death
summary: He took up bass after his brother, who died around 1935, had used his.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well, I, used to play bass, but I had taken it up after my brother died. See? Mm-hmm. See? In fact, I had bought a bass, so I let him have it, you see? Mm-hmm. And I just let him use it, but after he died. When did he die?
My brother's been dead now, but he died in about 30, 35, I think. Yes. Yeah.
